upgrade_description: Upgrade any outdated dependencies found in the tv-radio repo across all modules, including every package.json dependency/devDependency with a major-version gap, smaller logging/metrics clients such as winston, winston-logstash, influx, vendored front-end global scripts under tv-radio-admin/Admin/Interface/libs (Ember 1.13.3 trio, handlebars 3.0.3, jquery 1.11.0, socket.io 1.1.0), Solr compatibility from luceneMatchVersion 4.9 era config, and utilities ember-precompile.js/.sh dependency on deprecated optimist. Do not attempt full ember-cli rewrite; target newest version achievable without adopting ember-cli and flag if ember-cli migration is required to go further. Vendored socket.io client must remain in lockstep with tv-radio-admin/Admin/API socket.io server major.

breaking_changes: Express 4.9.5 to 5.x affects route/static middleware and removed/changed APIs such as express.static.mime.
Socket.IO 1.1.0 to 4.x is a protocol and middleware major jump; vendored admin socket.io-1.1.0.js must stay in lockstep with Admin/API socket.io server major.
MongoDB Node driver 2.x to 7.x affects MongoClient.connect return shape, db handles, collection count/update/remove/insert callbacks, ensureIndex, streams, and bulk operations.
Winston 1.x to 3.x and winston-logstash 0.x to 2.x affect logger construction, transports, and monkey-patched Logstash internals.
Solr config is luceneMatchVersion 4.9 era and schema uses solr.Trie*Field types; runtime Solr target remains unknown from repo files.

Ember 1.13.3 plus Handlebars 3 global admin UI uses ObjectController, classic views, Ember.Handlebars helpers/templates, Ember.Set, and Ember.$ AJAX; going beyond a non-ember-cli-compatible ceiling likely requires an ember-cli/framework migration.

jsonwebtoken 5 to 9, nodemailer 1 to 9, archiver 0 to 8, xmlbuilder 2 to 15, csv 0 to 6, uuid 2 to 14, and send 0 to 1 each have direct call sites or manifest exposure that require focused validation.
Deprecated packages request, optimist, fluent-ffmpeg, and gc-stats remain directly declared or used even where latest major is unchanged or deprecated.
risk_summary.notes: Primary language is Node.js/CommonJS JavaScript with vendored browser globals. Package manager is npm, but no package-lock.json/npm-shrinkwrap/yarn.lock files were found in the manifest scan, so exact installed transitive versions were not available. Entry points and validation context identified for later stages include tv-radio-admin/Admin/API/app.js on port 8080, tv-radio-frontend/app.js on port 8082, and tv-radio-admin/CLI/chapman.js maintenance commands. Datastore is declared empty for later validation planning.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index for tv-radio was available and current on 2026-08-05; GitNexus query confirmed admin API/CLI/search route areas, while line locations were captured with rg/Select-String for precision. npm view was used on 2026-08-05 to compare direct package latest versions. No dependency lockfiles were found, so dependency graph covers manifest direct dependencies plus vendored global scripts, not exact transitive installed versions. Solr was confirmed in tv-radio-admin/Settings/Solr and source clients, with luceneMatchVersion 4.9 in solrconfig.xml and solrconfig-records.xml; actual Solr runtime version and target version are unknown from repository files and must be confirmed by the orchestrator. MongoDB, Memcached, InfluxDB, and Logstash are detected as external services, but their runtime versions are unknown from repository files. Searches intentionally did not enumerate every line in vendored/minified library internals; affected frontend global files are represented by loading points, versioned filenames, and key generated/app-level Ember usage. Validation context retained for later stages: Admin/API startup node app.js in tv-radio-admin/Admin/API verify http://localhost:8080/; frontend startup node app.js in tv-radio-frontend verify http://localhost:8082/; CLI maintenance commands node chapman.js resetindex/index/geodata/courses --verbose; datastore_has_data=false.
